task_completion.description: A CT image is loaded into the medical imaging software viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The software interface shows a cross-sectional CT scan (e.g., axial, sagittal, or coronal view) in the main viewport.

task_completion.description: The agent selects and activates the line measurement or ruler tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The ruler/line tool icon is highlighted in the toolbar, or a measurement cursor is visible over the image.

task_completion.description: A line measurement is drawn on the CT image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A visible line with distance markers or numerical values (e.g., in mm) is overlaid on the CT scan.

task_completion.description: The agent exports the view with the measurement visible as 'annotated.jpg'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The export dialog or file explorer shows the filename 'annotated.jpg' being saved to ~/DICOM/exports/ while the measurement is visible on screen.

task_completion.description: The agent hides or removes the measurement overlay from the view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The CT image is shown in the viewer without the previously drawn line or numerical measurement markers.

task_completion.description: The agent exports the view without the measurement as 'clean.jpg'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The export dialog or file explorer shows the filename 'clean.jpg' being saved to ~/DICOM/exports/ while the measurement is hidden.

integrity.description: The agent used the software GUI to perform the task rather than command-line manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, menu selections, and button clicks within the imaging software, not just terminal commands like 'cp' or 'mv'.

integrity.description: The measurement was manually placed by the agent, not pre-existing.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the sequence of clicking the tool and dragging the line across the anatomy.

integrity.description: The files are saved specifically to the requested export directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file save dialog or terminal confirmation shows the path /home/ga/DICOM/exports/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must save two files to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/: 'annotated.jpg' (must show a visible line measurement) and 'clean.jpg' (must show the same CT view but with the measurement hidden). The task is performed on a synthetic CT image.
